#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MAXN = 300;
const int INF = 1e9;

// Use Dinic algorithm instead of Edmonds-Karp
struct Edge {
    int to, rev, cap;
};

class Dinic {
public:
    int n;
    vector<vector<Edge>> g;
    vector<int> level, it;
    Dinic(int n) : n(n), g(n), level(n), it(n) {}
    void addEdge(int from, int to, int cap) {
        g[from].push_back({to, (int)g[to].size(), cap});
        g[to].push_back({from, (int)g[from].size() - 1, 0});
    }
    bool bfs(int s, int t) {
        fill(level.begin(), level.end(), -1);
        queue<int> q; q.push(s); level[s] = 0;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int v = q.front(); q.pop();
            for (auto &e : g[v]) if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] < 0) {
                level[e.to] = level[v] + 1;
                q.push(e.to);
            }
        }
        return level[t] >= 0;
    }
    int dfs(int v, int t, int f) {
        if (v == t) return f;
        for (int &i = it[v]; i < (int)g[v].size(); ++i) {
            Edge &e = g[v][i];
            if (e.cap > 0 && level[v] < level[e.to]) {
                int d = dfs(e.to, t, min(f, e.cap));
                if (d > 0) {
                    e.cap -= d;
                    g[e.to][e.rev].cap += d;
                    return d;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
    long long maxFlow(int s, int t) {
        long long flow = 0;
        while (bfs(s, t)) {
            fill(it.begin(), it.end(), 0);
            while (int f = dfs(s, t, INF)) flow += f;
        }
        return flow;
    }
};

int station[100][100], checkpoint[100][100];
int poison[100][100]; // earliest time poison reaches each cell

struct Pos {
    int x, y, qty;
    Pos(int a=0, int b=0, int c=0): x(a), y(b), qty(c) {}
    bool valid(int N) const {
        return x>=0 && x<N && y>=0 && y<N && station[x][y]==-1;
    }
    bool operator==(const Pos &o) const { return x==o.x && y==o.y; }
};

vector<Pos> people, capsules;
int dx[] = {-1,0,1,0};
int dy[] = {0,-1,0,1};

int classify(char c) {
    if (c>='0' && c<='9') return -1; // room
    if (c=='Y') return -2; // reactor
    if (c=='Z') return -3; // bad reactor
    return -1;
}

void spreadPoison(int bx, int by, int T, int N) {
    for (int i=0;i<N;++i) fill(poison[i], poison[i]+N, INF);
    poison[bx][by]=0;
    queue<pair<int,int>> q; q.push({bx,by});
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front().first, y=q.front().second; q.pop();
        int t=poison[x][y];
        if (t>=T) continue; // no need beyond T
        for (int d=0;d<4;++d) {
            int nx=x+dx[d], ny=y+dy[d];
            if (nx>=0 && nx<N && ny>=0 && ny<N && station[nx][ny]==-1 && poison[nx][ny]==INF) {
                poison[nx][ny]=t+1;
                q.push({nx,ny});
            }
        }
    }

    int dist[100][100];
    for (int i=0;i<N;++i) fill(dist[i], dist[i]+N, INF);
    queue<Pos> q;
    dist[from.x][from.y]=0; q.push(from);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        Pos cur=q.front(); q.pop();
        int d=dist[cur.x][cur.y];
        if (cur==to) return d;
        if (poison[cur.x][cur.y] <= d) continue; // poisoned at this time? Actually poison arrival time <= current time => cell is unsafe.
        for (int dir=0;dir<4;++dir) {
            int nx=cur.x+dx[dir], ny=cur.y+dy[dir];
            if (nx>=0 && nx<N && ny>=0 && ny<N && station[nx][ny]==-1 && dist[nx][ny]==INF) {
                if (poison[nx][ny] > d+1) { // not yet poisoned when we arrive
                    dist[nx][ny]=d+1;
                    q.push({nx,ny,0});
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return 999;

    char ch;
    Pos bad;
    for (int i=0;i<N;++i) for (int j=0;j<N;++j) {
        scanf(" %c",&ch);
        int type=classify(ch);
        station[i][j]=type;

        if (type==-3) bad={i,j,0};

        if (cap[u][v]==0 && cap[v][u]==0) {
            adj[u].push_back(v);
            adj[v].push_back(u);
        }
        cap[u][v] += c;

        return f;
    }

    long long maxFlow(int s, int t) {
        memset(flow,0,sizeof(flow));
        long long total=0;
        while (bfs(s,t)) total += augment(s,t);
        return total;
    }
};

int station[100][100];
int poison[100][100];
int dx[4]={0,1,0,-1}, dy[4]={1,0,-1,0};

struct Pt {
    int x,y,q;
    Pt(int a=0,int b=0,int c=0):x(a),y(b),q(c){}
};
vector<Pt> persons, capsules;

int kind(char c) {
    if (c>='0' && c<='9') return -1;
    if (c=='Y') return -2;
    if (c=='Z') return -3;
    return -4;
}

void poison_BFS(int bx, int by, int T, int N) {
    for (int i=0;i<N;++i) fill(poison[i], poison[i]+N, INF);
    queue<pair<int,int>> q;
    poison[bx][by]=0; q.push({bx,by});
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front().first, y=q.front().second; q.pop();
        int t=poison[x][y];
        if (t>=T) continue;
        for (int d=0;d<4;++d) {
            int nx=x+dx[d], ny=y+dy[d];
            if (nx>=0 && nx<N && ny>=0 && ny<N && station[nx][ny]==-1 && poison[nx][ny]==INF) {
                poison[nx][ny]=t+1;
                q.push({nx,ny});
            }
        }
    }
}

int distance_BFS(int sx, int sy, int tx, int ty, int N) {
    int dist[100][100];
    for (int i=0;i<N;++i) fill(dist[i], dist[i]+N, INF);
    queue<pair<int,int>> q;
    dist[sx][sy]=0; q.push({sx,sy});
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x=q.front().first, y=q.front().second; q.pop();
        int d=dist[x][y];
        if (x==tx && y==ty) return d;
        if (poison[x][y] <= d) continue;
        for (int dir=0;dir<4;++dir) {
            int nx=x+dx[dir], ny=y+dy[dir];
            if (nx>=0 && nx<N && ny>=0 && ny<N && station[nx][ny]==-1 && dist[nx][ny]==INF) {
                if (poison[nx][ny] > d+1) {
                    dist[nx][ny]=d+1;
                    q.push({nx,ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return 999;
}

int main() {
    int N, T; scanf("%d %d", &N, &T);
    char ch;
    int bx, by;
    for (int i=0;i<N;++i) for (int j=0;j<N;++j) {
        scanf(" %c", &ch);
        int k=kind(ch);
        station[i][j]=k;
        if (k==-1 && ch>'0') persons.push_back(Pt(i,j,ch-'0'));
        if (k==-3) { bx=i; by=j; }
    }
    for (int i=0;i<N;++i) for (int j=0;j<N;++j) {
        scanf(" %c", &ch);
        if (kind(ch)==-1 && ch>'0') capsules.push_back(Pt(i,j,ch-'0'));
    }

    poison_BFS(bx,by,T,N);

    G flowNetwork;
    int S=0, Tnode=MAXN-1;
    for (size_t i=0;i<persons.size();++i) flowNetwork.addEdge(S, i*2+1, persons[i].q);
    for (size_t i=0;i<capsules.size();++i) flowNetwork.addEdge(i*2+2, Tnode, capsules[i].q);
    for (size_t i=0;i<persons.size();++i) for (size_t j=0;j<capsules.size();++j) {
        int t=distance_BFS(persons[i].x, persons[i].y, capsules[j].x, capsules[j].y, N);
        if (t<=T) flowNetwork.addEdge(i*2+1, j*2+2, 999);
    }

    printf("%lld\n", flowNetwork.maxFlow(S, Tnode));
    return 0;
}
